dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Heh! Ya still got a long way to go, <$cdef(27)>Mr. Mime! Might wanna
consider relearnin’ the fundamentals, I reckon!
<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,11)>Yooo... Seriously? I thought I was doin’ pretty good...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,43)>Ya won’t intimidate any opponents with slaps like those!

<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,4)>Oh, uh, these aren’t slap attacks or whatever, yo. I was
pantomiming.
<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,6)>Panta what now?

<$voicel(2,7)><$motionoff(2,814)><$comeff(2,10)>Uh, y’know, like...if I move like this, it makes you think
there’s a wall here you can’t see.
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>It’s pretty fun. You should give it a go, <$cdef(27)>Hariyama!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,39)>Well I’ll be... Them’s some fancy moves ya got there.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motionoff(1,806)>S’pose I can give it a try. Let’s see, now...
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,629)><$textsize(2)>HIYAHHH!!!<$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,5)>
<turn(1,270)><$voicel(2,1)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)><$motionoff(2,805)>Uhhh... You’re not s’posed to BREAK the wall, yo...

<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)>Gahaha! That so? Well, it was good trainin’ for me anyhow,
I tell ya what!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>OK, next it’s my turn to hide!

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Don’t worry, I’ll find you real quick. I’m good at
hide-and-seek! The seeking part in particular.
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Hmph! I’ll hide so good you’ll NEVER find me!

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,10)>But that’s what I mean!
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>You’re thinking real hard about hiding, and thoughts like
that leak out.<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)> I pick up on things like that!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Huh? Really? OK, so what am I thinking now? Guess!

<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Hmmm...
<$emotion(2,29)>You’re thinking about cheating, aren’t you?

<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Eep!
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Um, no... I wasn’t gonna cheat! I was just gonna
camouflage myself as something to help me hide!
<$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,6)>That’s cheating!

<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Umm...well...uh... Oh, I know!
<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,7)>I’ve got a quiz for you! What am I thinking NOW?!

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,4)>Let me see...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>“I’m done with hide-and-seek, but maybe you could say
my camouflage skills are really cool”?
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>WOWWW! You got it!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,3)>Hey... Don’tcha think we kinda look alike?
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Hmmm... You think so?

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)>Yeah, we really do! See, look at our ears—and the fur on
top of our heads!
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,14)>Now that you mention it...I guess we do! Weird!
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,8)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>! ♪ D’you think maybe we’re TWINS?!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,1)>Oh wow! I should call you Big Sis <$cdef(27)>Zorua from now on!
<$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,5)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)>Wait... It looks like we have a different number of tails.

<$comcan(2)><$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,807)>Huh? Oh, you’re right... Everything else matches, so I
wonder how come that’s different...
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,1)>Oh, I know!
<$voicel(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>What is it?

<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>I bet I’m gonna have six tails, too! They just haven’t grown
in yet!
<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,801)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,9)>If that happens, no one’ll be able to tell us apart anymore!
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,10)><$cdef(27)>Raichu</color>! Battle time, let’s go!

<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,6)>Oh, my! You’re back for another electricity contest? You’re
always bursting with energy, <$cdef(27)>Pikachu!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,664)><$comeff(1,9)>Today’s the day I take you down! Here I go!
<$voicel(1,10)><$facial(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,859)><$textsize(2)>CHUUUUUU!

<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>Goodness, how impressive! You’ve powered up since last
time, dear!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Ehehe! Sounds like this’ll be an easy win, then!

<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,806)><$comeff(2,14)>Hee hee... Well, I suppose I’d better not hold back...
<$voicel(2,10)><$facial(2,7)><$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,859)><$textsize(2)>CHUUUUUUUUU!
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,665)><$comeff(1,11)>HUH?! So much electricity, it’s unreal!

<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,802)><$comeff(2,4)>*gasp*... *huff puff*...
... ... ...
<$voicel(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$comeff(2,6)>So...how did you like my *huff*...electricity?

<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,663)><$comeff(1,7)>Urk... Fine—you beat me THIS time!
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)><$comeff(1,10)>See ya tomorrow, then!

<$voicel(2,1)><$motion(2,802)><$facial(2,9)><$comeff(2,17)>*wheeze*... *gasp* W-we’re doing this...tomorrow, too?
<$voicel(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)>Guess I’d better charge up somewhere... Oh, to be young
and full of energy!

<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>I hear you’ve been talkin’ big around these parts.
That true?

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Gwahaha! Sure is! ’Cause there ain’t nobody who can
beat me!
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>Wanna battle me ’n’ see fer yerself?

<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Interestin’ proposition! I ain’t never lost a battle myself...
You’re on!

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,8)>Never lost a battle, ya say? Gwahaha! Then I guess it’s up
to ME to send ya packin’ <$motion(1,815)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,10)>with one of my best moves!

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oho! That’s a powerful move ya got there! I can see why
you’re so fulla bluster!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>But that powerful move ain’t worth much if it can’t hit me!
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,4)>*fwoooooosh*
<$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>What?! You pulled a disappearin’ act on me!
<$comeff(2,9)><$voicel(2,7)>Gwahaha! Well? Still think ya can beat me?

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>You’re certainly makin’ it harder to aim, but I ain’t beat
yet! <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,10)>GRAAAHR! <$cdef(27)>Rock Slide combo attack!

<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,5)>Whoa! Careful now! I reckon ya’d feel real bad if ya hit
<$cdef(27)> with a stray rock!

<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>Grrrah! Guess I got a li’l too fired up! Sorry ’bout
that, <$cdef(27)>...

<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>Phew. You’re a wild one, all right... <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,2)>Ya may never have lost
a battle, but ya lose yer cool pretty often, don’t ya?

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,8)>I’m the best at mimicry! Just watch!
<$facial(2,4)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,10)>See? It’s you when you’re flying!

<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>... ... ...
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(2,8)>I’M the best at mimicry! Just watch, yo!
<$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(2,10)>See? It’s you when you’re flying!
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Wha—?!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>I was mimicking you! Sounded JUST like you, didn’t it?!
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Looks like I’m the best at mimicry for real, huh?

<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>I-I’m not gonna give up that easily! I’ve still got some
tricks up my sleeve...

<$lookat(2,0,0)><$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>!
Come to think of it, <$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>you’ve been mimicking a human
this whole time, haven’t you?

<$lookat(1,0,0)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Yooo... I hate to admit it, but I dunno if I’d stand a chance
against <$cdef(27)>...

<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Yeah... I’d get exhausted trying to mimic something for
so long...

<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Well, uh, then I guess the winner of the best mimicker
contest is...<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)><$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,8)>Ah... Watch out!
<$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,9)>Pahhh?! That scared me... <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>What was that all the sudden?

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, I saw a tree branch flying on the wind this way, so I
merely sliced it away. <$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>You’re not injured, are you?

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,8)>Oh...I’m fine, thank you!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>I have to say, you looked so cool just now, <$cdef(27)>Empoleon! <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>You
were all like “swish!”
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Ah, you’re referring to the move I used to cut the branch?

<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,9)>Yeah! That’s what I meant! I couldn’t see it well because
it was so fast... <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,8)>Could you do it again, please?
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,5)>Yes, of course. A trivial task. Now watch closely... <wait(1.0)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,814)><$voicel(2,10)>Yah!

<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Wow, amazing! How do you do that? <$emotion(1,58)><$voicel(1,4)>N-not that I want to
try to do it or anything...

<$emotion(2,50)><$voicel(2,9)>Haha, you’re perfectly capable of it. Why not attempt it
and see for yourself?
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Wha—?! R-really?

<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>I’ll give you a slower demonstration. Try to do as I do.
<$comcan(2)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,8)>Yah! Like that.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,5)>All right, I can do this... <$motion(1,668)><$facial(1,7)><$voicel(1,10)>Yah!
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>How was that? I thought it was pretty good...

<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Heh heh. You have admirable form. I look forward to
seeing what the future holds for you.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Jolteon</color>... Do you only eat one kind of berry?
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>Huh? No, why?
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>Well, your home’s filled with piles of the same berry.

<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Ohhh, you mean my snack stash! Funny story: I grabbed a
berry to eat later, <$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>and next thing I knew, it was gone!
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>But these things happen, right? So I went out to pick up
another one, but when I came back, I found the old one.
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>And I always grab the same kind of berry to replace the
one I thought I lost!

<$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,5)>Wait, this happened more than once? And that’s why you
have so many? Wow, <$cdef(27)>Jolteon... You’re something else.
<$comeff(1,20)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Say, why don’t I help you clear some of them away?

<$comeff(2,1)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Whoa, you serious? That’d be awesome!
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>To be honest, it’s kinda annoying when I wake up to find
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>a bunch of berries stuck on my spiky bod.
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>If you don’t mind helping me tidy, I’d really appreciate it!

<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>No problem, just leave it to me.
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)>First, I’ll flood your whole place with a gush of water...

<$emotion(2,58)><$voicel(2,7)>Whoa, hey, hold up, pal! My home’ll get totally soaked if
you do that!

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Well, yeah. The berries get washed away, plus your home
gets nice and damp. <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>What’s the problem?

<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>The problem? Well, I don’t really wanna live in a wetland,
for starters...
<$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,1)>Y’know what, forget about it. I’ll get rid of ’em myself...
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Hey! Could I have some of your wool?
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Sure... But why, though?

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>I just thought that if I filled my home with your wool, it’d
be all fluffy and nice!

<$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,6)>Ohhh...
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,3)>But my wool is so light, it could get blown away if
it’s ever windy, y’know.

<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>Oh, right... That’s not good...
<$comeff(2,20)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Wait! If we combined a bunch of wool with my string,
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>could that keep it from blowing away?

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Ohhh, yeah! You might be a genius... <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>That sounds
fun, so lemme, y’know, help out!

<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,9)>Thanks! Now the question is, <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,6)>HOW do we combine your
wool and my string...

<$comcan(2)><$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Y’know, the idea of combining wool and string kinda
reminds me of <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>those human tools
<$cdef(27)> makes.

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,9)>You’re right! Let’s start by getting something made by
<$cdef(27)>,
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)>and
studying
it carefully!
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Yeahhh! Study buddies! <$emotion(1,60)><$voicel(1,10)>Woot woot!
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,10)>Woo-hoo!
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Hey! You don’t know any good hiding spots, do you?

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Hiding spots?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Hm... How about inside a cave or in the shade of a tree?
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>No one will bother you there, so you can rest easy.

<$emotion(2,18)><$voicel(2,7)>Nah, that’s no fun! I wanna find a spot where I can hide
then jump <$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>out and scare folks! Hehe!

<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh dear. Up to a little mischief, are you? I wonder what
I would do if you pulled that little prank on me.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Perhaps I’d wrap you up tightly in a bundle of my thread...
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>Uh...what?
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Then I’d hang you up and leave you there, alone, afraid...
<$comeff(2,11)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,10)>Whoa, WHAT?!
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Don’t worry, I’m only teasing! I would never do that.
<$emotion(2,58)><$voicel(2,8)><$kfacial(2)>O-oh! Haha, good one!

<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>But don’t you think troublemakers who thoughtlessly
frighten others deserve a taste of their own medicine?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>I certainly do. That is why you mustn’t pull too many
pranks, little <$cdef(27)>Gastly. Otherwise, well...
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,23)><$facial(2,9)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,9)>I-I won’t! I promise! Please don’t tie me up!

<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>*rumble*... I’m so hungry...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Hey, do you have anything I could eat?
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Well, I dooo have some berries...

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Really? Can I have some, then? I’m so hungry I feel like
I’m gonna collapse...
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Suuure. They have a little sludge on them, though...
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,6)>What’s wrong with that?

<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,1)>Some Pokémon don’t liiike sludgy berries. <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,18)><$voicel(1,8)>But here, you
can have one if you don’t mind...

<$emotion(2,63)><$voicel(2,8)>Fine with me! Thanks...
<$motion(2,17)><$voicel(2,5)>*chomp*! *munch munch*...<$motion(2,19)>
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Whoa... The sludge makes it so creamy and tasty!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Reeeaaally? I’m glad, then... I guess...

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Yeah... I like it a lot! It’s so good.
<$comeff(2,20)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Ooh, I’ve got an idea. We should try putting sludge on
other foods, too!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Like, on vegetables, and y’know, full meals...
<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>Huh? I dunno... That seems like a lot of wooork...
<$emotion(1,18)><$voicel(1,3)>Hmmmmmm... I don’t know what to dooo...
<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Is something the matter?

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,8)>Yeeeaaah. You see, um...
